fields.summary: [AI chat] Show existing chat wrapper after verified model connection

content.text: User story: As a signed-in individual, I want the existing AI chat box to become available after a successful connection to my effective configured model, so that I can converse with the provider/model I selected personally or inherited from my current organization. User explicitly requested creating the ticket before implementation.

Existing source verified: EnsuredUI/src/components/marketplace/withChatbot.tsx renders Chatbot.tsx. It is currently mounted on Pages/LandingPage/LandingPage.tsx. Chatbot uses local answerFor canned responses and its own open/minimize/audio controls; it is not a live authenticated model chat. Reuse and extend this wrapper instead of building a duplicate UI. Model settings, current-scope resolution and connection-test endpoint already exist under AIN-138/139/140; Muse adapter remains AIN-137.

Acceptance 1: After a successful model connection test, show the existing chat box/affordance in the authenticated application using the existing open/minimize behavior. Hide/unavailable before an effective saved model is verified, while unconfigured, or after a failed test. Merely saving configuration or having an API key is not evidence of connectivity. Loading and connection failure states are explicit.

Acceptance 2: Gate visibility and send authorization using server-verified connection state for the exact effective configuration scope/revision, provider/model and current authenticated account membership. A personal override supersedes an organization connection result; testing organization settings must not unlock an unverified personal override. Support inherited organization settings and independent personal accounts. A browser flag/localStorage value alone must never authorize chat.

Acceptance 3: Restore verified status on reload/navigation using authoritative state with a documented freshness policy. Invalidate/recheck after provider/model/key/endpoint changes, return to inheritance, organization revision changes, membership removal/change, logout/account switching, failed reconnect, or provider authentication/permission failure. Prevent a late successful test from enabling a newer untested configuration. Avoid repeated automatic billable probes on every page render.

Acceptance 4: Send conversation requests through an authenticated server endpoint using current effective model settings and stored credentials. Do not send credentials to the browser or accept a caller-forged provider/scope as authority. Display actual selected-provider replies, loading/sending state and errors; do not present answerFor canned responses as live model output. Preserve or safely clear account/config-scoped history and prevent cross-account/tenant disclosure.

Acceptance 5: Preserve the wrapper’s existing open/minimize/accessibility behavior and verify keyboard and narrow-screen use. Provide bounded history/request sizes, empty-input validation, duplicate-send protection and explicit failure/retry. Connection loss must disable/hide the live chat appropriately and provide a path back to model settings without losing unsent text unnecessarily. Reconcile the public landing-page demo separately so it does not falsely claim a verified personal/organization model connection.

Verification / Definition of Done: executable isolated Storybook play stories assert hidden-before-connect, exact successful effective-config unlock, inherited/personal precedence, reload, stale test race, changed credentials/model, disconnected/retry, logout/membership revocation, send payload and actual observable reply/error, empty/loading and narrow/keyboard states. Synthetic transports must block accidental application writes. Pagination is not needed for the bounded initial conversation; document history limits. Authenticated API/database integration tests prove authoritative verification, current membership, tenant/account separation and server-side provider routing. Include a configured-provider conversation and integrated staging evidence with build/provider/model versions; mocked replies alone do not prove live chat.

Ticket-to-component-to-story-to-verification mapping is required in Jira and TASK_HANDOFF.md before Done. Add regression tickets for discovered defects. Preserve generated-form and financial authorization boundaries; this request is chat, not authorization for new autonomous business/financial writes. No credentials in tickets, logs or evidence.

Dependencies and exclusions: Required milestone from AIN-138/139 is effective organization/personal settings resolution plus connection testing; this does not replace or close their remaining original acceptance/staging gates. AIN-137 is related adapter ownership and remains required for Muse-specific proof. Parent AIN-2 and AIN-87 retain all broader obligations. Exclude rebuilding the wrapper, unimplemented provider adapters, public anonymous use of stored organization credentials, and unrelated pipeline/financial features. User’s earlier hands-on account test remains deferred until they return. No implementation, deployment, sprint commitment, assignee or estimate is claimed by creating this backlog entry.
